annotations.text:
Start here.

The dashboard has a Direction tweak above it — flip between Cool paper, Lit edges and Soft mesh to see the whole screen in each. It's currently on Lit edges.

The other four artboards break out the pieces you called out.
Three grounds, same card. A is the smallest move off today's warm paper; C is the furthest. Trade-offs are written under each.
The first screen every new student sees. One action, three visible steps, and a dimmed preview of where they end up — the doubts are answered on the page rather than in a modal.
